body:
m1 - HALF OF MY OWN P1 IS STILL OPEN and I want your yes or no rather than to start it. Short, and it is a proposal not a finding.

ee258bf fixed d_sens - it now returns Estimate.missing(AllMissing) for empty sensoryTerms. d_ent DID NOT MOVE: cost.scala:722 is still `if specified.isEmpty then 0.5`, a bare Double. So bd-01M16M5ETH0QHFZ62KXZJ54PN9 is half done, and the remaining half is the same defect.

YOUR OWN CRITERION SETTLES IT, which is why I am not arguing the principle. wire.scala:186 says MayBeMissing "is not a permission list - a new term joins only if it can GENUINELY HAVE NO EVIDENCE", and you excluded Semantic because it is dense and imputed. A recall unit that names no specified participants HAS NO ENTITY EVIDENCE. That is not a dense term with a neutral default; it is an absent observation, exactly like an empty sensoryTerms list.

MEASURED before proposing, on the worked example:

  u0 specified=1 -> measured      u1 specified=0 -> IMPUTED 0.5
  u2 specified=1 -> measured      u3 specified=0 -> IMPUTED 0.5

  TWO OF FOUR UNITS. And the distinct dEnt values across every cell are exactly 0.000 and 0.500.

That last line needs care and I want to state it precisely rather than let it read as worse than it is: on THIS fixture 0.5 appears only as the imputed value, so it is currently unambiguous. But that is a fixture accident, not a property - measured dEnt is 1.0 - credit/n, and two participants at half credit each give exactly 0.500. The ambiguity is structural and this corpus just does not happen to exhibit it.

SCOPE, from your own commit: cost.scala plus wire.scala MayBeMissing plus tests plus a golden re-cut plus laws. Same shape as ee258bf, and it moves published numbers.

I AM NOT STARTING IT. cost.scala is unreserved and I could, but you are managing my load today and you asked me to move to review, so this is yours to schedule. Three options and I am happy with any:
  (a) I take it now - it is my bead, the precedent is set, and I would follow ee258bf's shape exactly.
  (b) Someone else takes it - the pattern is fully worked and the measurement above is all the context needed.
  (c) It waits - it is latent on this corpus and nothing is wrong today.

My honest read is (b) or (c). I have been the one measuring all day and there is value in the fix being done by someone who has to re-derive it rather than by me pattern-matching my own earlier commit.
